card.name: The word study in news reports
card.fires_on: The word "study" when it refers to a research study in health news, often after "a new", "the", or "recent". It also appears before "researcher" or "authors".

modes.label: Study as the subject
modes.description: "study" follows an article such as "the", "a new" or "a recent" and introduces what the research found.
modes.example: Now, a new<< study>> suggests tanning parlors are fighting back

modes.label: Study as a modifier
modes.description: "study" comes right before a role word such as researcher or authors.
modes.example: The idea, said<< study>> researcher Donard Dwyer, is

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated name and fragment pieces, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "study" when a news story reports on new research.
